'''Naporitan''' or '''napolitan''' (ナポリタン) is the name of a [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]] dish, which is popular in Japan. It is claimed to originate from Yokohama.

==Ingredients==

* 7 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (170 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Spaghetti|spaghetti]]
* 1 green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* ½ small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], thinly sliced
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (110 g) [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]] or [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]], sliced
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]], to taste

==Procedure==

# Put about 8 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] of water in a large pot, and add 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] salt. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] on high heat and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
# Meanwhile, heat vegetable oil in a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] and [[Cookbook:Stir-frying|stir-fry]] onion, bell pepper, and sausage on medium heat until softened. Season with salt and pepper.
# Add drained spaghetti in the skillet and stir-fry with other ingredients. 
# Add ketchup and stir-fry the spaghetti. Mix in butter and stop the heat.
